evidence.title: how to better use AI (before prompting): - by Ruben Hassid

name: how to better use AI (before prompting)
summary: Guide to what to set up before typing a prompt: thinking mode, search, and giving the AI context instead of collecting prompts.
description: A How to AI issue arguing that results depend on setup before the prompt: turn on thinking mode, use search to avoid made-up answers, stop re-introducing yourself in every chat, and feed the model documents and examples. Ends with a short TL;DR.
